thread: Follow the swarm from wave-washed tide pools into a towering kelp forest, then descend into the dark deep sea. Along the way it meets gripping sea stars, drifting jellies, luminous animals, and the machines that explore their habitats.

candidates.name: Seattle Aquarium
candidates.why: Begin along the rocky shore with tide-pool animals, pinto abalone, sea stars, and the kelp and coastal ecosystems they inhabit.

candidates.name: Monterey Bay Aquarium
candidates.why: Travel through kelp forests among sea otters, rockfish, swaying algae, and drifting jellies, with animal and ecosystem guides to explore.

candidates.name: Monterey Bay Aquarium Research Institute
candidates.why: Descend into the deep with animal profiles, underwater vehicles, instruments, and expeditions revealing transparent bodies and bioluminescent adaptations.

candidates.name: Smithsonian Ocean
candidates.why: Explore coasts, reefs, and the deep through richly linked accounts of invertebrates, fish, plankton, algae, and their habitats.

candidates.name: NOAA Ocean Exploration
candidates.why: Meet deep-sea corals, sponges, remotely operated vehicles, and seafloor habitats through expeditions, animal guides, and exploration technology.

candidates.name: Reeflex Marine Encyclopedia
candidates.why: Browse a profusion of reef life, from sea pens and nudibranchs to mantis shrimp, frogfish, and branching corals.

candidates.name: California Academy of Sciences
candidates.why: Its tide-pool guides, aquarium exhibits, creature closeups, and scientific expeditions offer anemones, chitons, reef fish, and other marine forms.

candidates.name: Schmidt Ocean Institute
candidates.why: Follow ocean expeditions into submarine canyons and deep reefs, with research vehicles, dive archives, and newly observed sea life.

candidates.name: National Oceanography Centre
candidates.why: Explore deep-sea creatures, research collections, underwater vehicles, and ocean science, including giant isopods and ghostsharks.
